title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. translated_title: 知道何时让步：基于文本的具身智能体中用户纠正的有据仲裁
translated_abstract: 当一个人的纠正可能是错误的时候，具身智能体应该如何回应？我们将基于事实的纠正仲裁形式化为在接受、拒绝、查看环境以及询问说话者四种行为之间的选择。GAVA通过有观测边界限制的证据、合法的探查动作以及一步期望损失规则来实现这一接口。在纯文本的ALFWorld环境中，162个检查点产生了972对配对的真假干预。完整的局部检查使GAVA和“总是验证”策略均达到100%的纠正准确率，这表明该准确率源自证据契约的确立而非某种比较优势。在同一回合执行中，与“总是验证”策略相比，GAVA降低了交互成本，但在完美说话者条件下与成本阈值持平。一种仅在训练阶段使用的探索性物体位置先验，在340个未见场景中相较于均匀GAVA将交互成本和声明的联合成本分别降低了0.490和0.420。在冻结策略、成本、基线和多重性方案之后，这些收益得以复现。
tldr: 提出了GAVA框架，使具身智能体在面对可能错误的用户纠正时，能够在接受、拒绝、查看环境与询问用户之间做出基于观测证据的仲裁决策，在保持100%纠正准确率的同时有效降低交互成本。
en_tdlr: GAVA is a grounded arbitration framework that enables embodied agents to decide when to accept, reject, inspect the world, or ask the speaker when faced with potentially wrong user corrections, achieving 100% correction accuracy while reducing interaction costs.
